name: unifi-site-manager
description: Read-only UniFi Site Manager cloud access for every location: hosts, sites, devices, health, WAN metrics, SD-WAN status, and Network site-to-site VPN status. Uses an api.ui.com API key. Does not log in to a local controller and does not change the network.

UNIFI_SITE_MANAGER_API_KEY.description: Site Manager API key from unifi.ui.com. Sent only as the X-API-KEY header to https://api.ui.com. This is not the local UniFi Network username, password, or controller integration key.
